mission.title: Final Reckoning

npc.say: Fool! By coming here you've guaranteed your own death!

phase.briefing:
The time has come, {player}. The Colonel is about to become a mere blemish on the pages of Matrix history. I have chosen you to carry out this assignment.
Your HUD is displaying the Colonel's likely coordinates. Proceed there and eliminate all opposition.

enter.say: I can't sort these signals out... keep an eye open!

phase.briefing:
The commandos seem to think that their Colonel's location is some sort of secret. Unfortunately for them, we have gleaned something about their nature. The Colonel's location is plain to any who know what we know.
Your HUD has been updated. Proceed.

enter.say: Something about their nature? I'm lost... but whatever, just get in there and ice the Colonel!

mission.finish:
Your assistance has once again proven invaluable, {player}. You have removed an obstacle from our path.
Your service will be remembered.
